summary: Haleon plc filed a Form 6-K announcing the publication of listing particulars for its EMTN programme, a routine annual update to its Euro Medium Term Note Programme. The filing notes no specific transaction, change in control, activist, or restructuring event. It is a standard debt programme documentation update. No terms such as price per share, premium, or implied value are stated. The reporting is informational for debt investors. This is not a special situation; it is an ordinary capital markets housekeeping filing.
